menu: Activities → Programmes → programme → Settings → Make-up sessions

fields.label: Allow make-up sessions
fields.help: Check to enable the use of make-up sessions for this programme based on your settings.

fields.label: Make-up sessions waitlist
fields.help: Clients will be able to enrol on a waitlist for an make-up session

fields.label: Allow the use of credit for a make-up session as a discount when purchasing a programme
fields.help: Credits allocated to clients have a unit value calculated from the class price. If this option is enabled, the client will be offered the opportunity to use such credits as a discount on the purchase when enrolling or the next programme. The credits will be automatically used and the client will lose the entitlement for these make-up sessions.

fields.label: Allow tailored make-up sessions
fields.help: Clients will be able to propose a tailored make-up session date according to their preferences. Each request for a tailored make-up session will be approved by their instructor.

fields.label: Automatic approval of tailored make-up sessions
fields.help: If this instructor is available on this date, the make-up session will be automatically approved.

fields.label: Allow make-up sessions at other companies
fields.help: It will allow clients from other companies to replace sessions in this programme. You manage the companies whose clients can use the make-up sessions in the settings.

fields.label: Limit for make-up sessions
fields.help: The number is set for each booking and within a set period. If the value is set to 0, the number of make-up sessions = the number of sessions in the class.

fields.label: Number of days to use make-up sessions
fields.help: The specified number of days will start counting down according to the settings below - before or after the class ends. So for example if you set the limit to 10 days, then the last day when clients can use their make-up sessions would be the last class date plus 10 days. This setting will limit the length of validity for make-up sessions that is specified in the general settings. If the value is set to 0, the expiration of make-up sessions applies from the general settings.

fields.label: Allow clients to reschedule/change an already selected make-up session
fields.help: If this setting is turned off, clients will not be able to change an already scheduled make-up session. However, they will still be able to cancel.

fields.label: Make-up sessions are assigned by an administrator
fields.help: When enabled, clients can still cancel a session, but they cannot pick or reschedule their make-up session themselves. An administrator assigns it for them.

fields.label: Flexible limit of make-up sessions
fields.help: The limit of make-up sessions will be applied to the package of sessions. For example, for every 5 sessions, the client will be entitled to 3 make-up sessions. Suitable to be used in cases where the class may be extended with additional sessions during the programme of the class.

fields.label: Number of sessions for which the limit is valid
When cancelling of the make-up session, return the credit to the client
fields.help: As a standard, the client loses his/her entitlement to the make-up session after cancelling of it. If this feature is enabled, the client will regain the entitlement to the make-up session after cancelling of the make-up session.

Click on the button to apply the settings for using make-up sessions to all unused make-up sessions (not just new ones).

fields.label: Availability settings
options: In this programme only, but in all classes
Only the class the client is enrolled in

fields.label: Show nicknames only
fields.help: When active, clients can only see the nickname.

intro: Manage your Zooza subscription in one place. Here you can review your current plan, change your subscription, and download invoices. All subscription management is handled securely in our billing application.

notes: Attention. This setting may not apply if you have the make-up session expiration mode set to end of class in the general settings. Please check in the main make-up session settings that you have the make-up session mode set to Expires after a preset number of days to prevent make-up session credits from expiring at the end of a class.
